items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: I think Lee Collins playing with the Astoria Hot 8 on that Label X.

ctx.x: What about half-valving though? That isn't legitimate. How some of them do that?

Oh no. He was talking just about the way he was holding it. Yeah. Well this... You see now a valve instrument, a trombone player, he can do all sorts of little things. Lissandos because he's got a slime and a valve instrument doesn't. And these are where the real subtlies involved in the music. And I think it would take a young guy playing. I work on that half-valve stuff all the time because I think that's where you can get the real shadings and the meanings and the blues. Anything can play. Lee Collins... I…
I noticed the D does a lot of that with his lip too, not just with his... Yeah.
